title: A Cross-Polytope Geometry of the Primes - code and sources v1.0.1
description:
LaTeX source, compiled PDF, figures, graphical abstract and the complete Python code behind every numerical finding of the preprint A Cross-Polytope Geometry of the Primes: Orbit Minima, Exact Residue Counts, and Singular Series by Thomas Krause, Preprints (2026), doi:10.20944/preprints202611.0311.v1.

The code reproduces the four structural theorems (orbit criterion, symmetry key lemma, completeness of orbit minima for k ≥ 6 with sharpness at k = 5, and the recursion pk+1 = min Bk \ {1}) for k = 3..7, and recomputes all numerical findings with an independent NumPy sieve up to 108.
